اعتورتما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَوَرْتُمَا (iʕtawartumā) /iʕ.ta.war.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# اُعْتُوِرْتُمَا (uʕtuwirtumā) /uʕ.tu.wir.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
